hh.dd.autoHint: These were merged on an identical PMID/DOI/PMCID/EID. If they are different after all, undo it.
hh.dd.batch.intro: Accepts only the pending proposals matching the filter; the filter is recorded in the decision. Resolution proposals cannot be accepted this way.
hh.dd.batch.matching: Proposals in the list matching the filter: {n}
hh.dd.batch.minBad: The score must be a number between 0 and 1.
hh.dd.batch.minHint: Between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.97; empty: no lower bound
hh.dd.batch.reason: Batch acceptance with a filter from the workbench (proposals reviewed side by side).
hh.dd.batch.title: Batch accept
hh.dd.f.title: Title
hh.dd.feat.title: title similarity: {v}
hh.dd.guide: Compare the items side by side; differing fields are marked ≠. When in doubt, do not merge.
hh.dd.noStudies: No record list yet (studies.json): run identification, then de-duplication.
hh.dd.rejectIntro: The items stay separate. A rationale is optional but helps later review.
hh.dd.undoIntro: Write why they are different reports (e.g. 'wrong DOI in one record').
hh.ep.EP4: EP4: eligibility against your own PICO
hh.ev6.heading: Verifying secondary data (EP6)
hh.ev6.intro: Give where you checked it in the primary report (e.g. 'rec-pmid-… page 5, Table 2').
hh.ev6.lead: Numbers of included studies taken from reviews. Open the primary report and record where you checked it; only verified numbers can be analysed.
hh.ev6.none: No unverified secondary numbers in the included studies.
hh.ex.batchBody: You confirm {n} proposed candidates of {label} (unknown-role items known only from the reference list are left out — confirm those one by one: confirming means the review INCLUDED it). The filter is recorded in the decision. Only do this after reviewing the quotes.
hh.ex.caption: Candidates of {label}
hh.ex.guide: Confirm or reject the medium and low confidence candidates (with a reason). High-confidence ones can be overridden too. Confirming an unknown-role item (known only from the reference list) means the review INCLUDED it — decide those one by one, from the quote.
hh.ex.noCandidates: No candidates extracted from this review yet.
hh.ex.rejectIntro: Write why it is not an included study (e.g. 'background reference only').
hh.ex.resolveHint: PMID/DOI/NCT are accepted only from a database response; identifiers from the review are also checked via API.
hh.ex.sdFallbackHint: The search date is not reported: publication minus 12 months is the estimate (cautious, gives a wider update window). You approve it in the Update step.
hh.ex.secondaryTitle: Number taken from the review: unverified; check against the primary report before analysis (EP6).
hh.exp.hint: Always into exports/: studies.ma.json, records.ris, screening.csv, masodlagos_adatok.csv (verification worklist), search log. Secondary numbers never go into the analysis table.
hh.exp.outcomeBad: Only letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore (max 64).
hh.exp.prisma: PRISMA into the project (02_szures/prisma_flow.json) — only if it does not exist
hh.exp.title: Exports
hh.exp.toProject: into the project (03_adatok/studies.json) — only if it does not exist
hh.head.cliMissing: The headhunter command line is unavailable
hh.head.notInit: Metaheadhunter has not been started in this project — begin with the 'Question (PICO)' step.
hh.head.problems: {n} headhunter files do not match their schema (H001). Fix them or rerun the affected step.
hh.head.question: Question:
hh.intro.lead: Finds published systematic reviews and meta-analyses on your topic, extracts their included studies (with evidence), identifies and merges them; you screen against your own PICO and get one merged study list with PRISMA counts, complemented by an update search. The tool proposes and records — every decision is yours.
hh.intro.title: Metaheadhunter — mining existing meta-analyses
hh.job.cancelAsked: Cancellation requested: the step stops before its next request; data already fetched is kept.
hh.job.partial: One or more sources were unreachable, so the result is partial (H014). The gap is in the search log; repeat later.
hh.lockedBody: Start Metaheadhunter with your question (PICO) before this step.
hh.mg.signoffBlocked: Sign-off is not possible yet: open decisions ({eps}).
hh.mg.signoffIntro: You sign off the inclusion of {studies} studies ({reports} reports). The sign-off is your decision; later changes need a new decision.
hh.mg.signoffReady: No open decisions: you can sign off the final inclusion.
hh.nav.title: Metaheadhunter
hh.ov.bands: Bands (guidance): 0–5% slight · 6–10% moderate · 11–15% high · above 15% very high (Pieper 2014; Ying 2025).
hh.ov.capped: Showing the first {n} rows (of {total}); full matrix: exports/overlap_matrix.csv
hh.ov.fewReviews: Pairwise overlap needs at least two reviews.
hh.pico.approveNote: Approving the PICO is recorded in the decision log as your decision.
hh.pico.forceBody: The new question and concept blocks replace the old ones; the decision log is kept and dependent steps become stale.
hh.pico.interventionHint: Separated by semicolons, e.g. BCG vaccine; BCG
hh.pico.outcomesHint: Separated by semicolons; does not narrow the search
hh.pico.populationHint: Separated by semicolons, e.g. tuberculosis; TB
hh.pico.question: Research question
hh.pr.copy: The project PRISMA file ({path}) receives the counts by export, only if it does not exist yet.
hh.pr.engine: The engine checks the counts; the screen does not compute.
hh.pr.footnote: Footnote: citations in total (with duplicates): {total} · excluded on title (other branch): {title} · already known (update): {known}
hh.pr.none: No PRISMA counts yet: run the merge or update the PRISMA counts.
hh.pr.title: PRISMA 2020 (Metaheadhunter)
hh.reason.codeMissing: Choose an exclusion reason (required at full-text level, PRISMA 16a).
hh.reason.noPhi: Goes into the decision log: do not write patient data (name, ID number, date of birth).
hh.rv.empty: No reviews yet. Start the search.
hh.rv.excludeIntro: The reason goes into the decision log (EP1).
hh.rv.guide: Select every systematic review that fits your PICO; give a reason when excluding.
hh.rv.includeIntro: The included studies of the selected review will be extracted in the next step. A rationale is optional.
hh.rv.scoreTitle: Ranking score (ordering only, not a quality judgement)
hh.rv.selectFirst: Select at least one review first.
hh.sc.conflicts: The reviews' numbers differ in {n} fields — the primary report decides.
hh.sc.decideIntro: A reason code is required for full-text exclusion (PRISMA 16a).
hh.sc.guide: Decide inclusion on your own criteria; the earlier reviews' decisions are only context.
hh.sc.keys: Keys: ↑/↓ move · I include · X exclude (with reason) · T exclude on title/abstract · N not retrieved · W awaiting
hh.sc.noMerged: No merged list yet. Build it (merge), then screen here.
hh.sc.provNote: In brackets: the evidence identifiers (shown with their quotes in the Extraction step).
hh.sc.secondaryNote: Reported by the review, not the primary report: verify before analysis (EP6).
hh.src.beforeInit: You can check the sources before starting; switching them on/off is possible after start (recorded as a decision).
hh.src.caption: Source status
hh.src.col.name: Source
hh.src.keysHint: Keys only from environment variables (e.g. MA_SCOPUS_APIKEY) — never type them here.
hh.step.dedupe.lead: The same article from several reviews, or several reports of the same study: decide the proposals (EP3).
hh.step.dedupe.title: Duplicates
hh.step.extract.lead: Included studies of the selected reviews, each with a verbatim quote from the source; confirm the uncertain ones (EP2).
hh.step.extract.title: Extraction
hh.step.merge.lead: One row per study with provenance, PRISMA 2020 counts, sign-off (EP5) and exports.
hh.step.merge.title: Merge and PRISMA
hh.step.overlap.lead: How far the source reviews included the same studies (CCA, overall and pairwise).
hh.step.overlap.title: Overlap
hh.step.pico.lead: Enter your question and the search concept blocks; the approval is recorded as your decision.
hh.step.pico.title: Question (PICO)
hh.step.reviews.lead: Find existing reviews on your topic and choose which ones to mine (EP1).
hh.step.reviews.title: Reviews
hh.step.screen.lead: Decide every study against YOUR OWN PICO; record a reason for exclusions (EP4).
hh.step.screen.title: Screening
hh.step.sources.lead: Choose the databases to search and check that they are reachable from here.
hh.step.sources.title: Sources
hh.step.update.lead: Date-limited search since the source reviews' latest search date; you approve the window.
hh.step.update.title: Update
hh.steps.label: Metaheadhunter steps
hh.up.approveBody: The window (start, end, overlap) is recorded as your decision, then the date-limited search runs in the selected sources. You decide the new records in the de-duplication and screening steps.
hh.up.incomplete: Paging stopped or hit the cap: the PRISMA count is not final.
hh.up.monthsBad: The overlap is a whole number between 0 and 60 (months).
hh.up.endHint: Empty: today. Set it to make the search repeatable (e.g. the cut-off date in your protocol).
hh.up.monthsHint: Default 6 — a pragmatic default for indexing delay
hh.up.none: No update search has run yet.
hh.up.summary: Retrieved: {retrieved} · duplicates within: {dup} · already known: {known} · new records: {fresh}
hh.sc.nextHint: Screening (EP4) is closed. Next step: the update search (or merge and PRISMA).
hh.up.capHint: Empty: 5000. If the search would return more, the step is flagged incomplete (H012) — narrow it or raise this.
hh.up.capBad: The cap is a whole number between 1 and 100,000.
